@help:
# Mind Map

## Mouse
- double-click — edit a title or list
- right-click — branch menu
- click the circle — collapse the branch
- wheel, touchpad pinch, Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- — zoom; drag a branch — order and level, drag empty space — pan

## Keys
- Tab / Enter — child / sibling branch
- Shift+Enter — list under a node (line = item, "1. " at the start — numbered)
- F2 / Ctrl+Enter — edit, Del — delete
- arrows — navigate, Alt+arrows — move
- Ctrl+E — source, Ctrl+P — PDF
- F1 — help, "File → Tutorial" — practice map

## List under a node
> - small text under the title
> - ▾ collapses, ▸ expands
> - in Markdown: "> - item"

## Links and checkboxes
> A note under a node — lines "> text" in Markdown.
- [website](https://markmap.js.org) — in the browser
- [folder](~/) — opens in the file manager, [branch](#mouse) — jumps to the node
- you can drop a file or link onto a node
- [ ] checkbox — click to check it off
@helpHtml:
Help

The map is stored as plain Markdown: headings and list items are branches. Edit on the map or in the source (Ctrl+E); both sides stay in sync.

Mouse

Double-click a titleedit the title right in the node
Double-click a list or noteedit the list (line = item, "1. " on the first line — numbered) or note; same via right-click → "Edit List" / "Edit Note"
Click a branchselect
Right-click a branch / empty spacebranch menu / map menu
Click the circlecollapse or expand the branch; Ctrl+click — with all nested branches
Drag a branch by its titlethe root cannot be dragged; onto the top third of another branch — insert before it, onto the bottom third — after it, onto the middle — make it a child; near the window edge the canvas scrolls by itself
Drag empty spacepan the canvas
Wheel / touchpad pinchzoom
Click ▾ / ▸ at a listcollapse or expand the list under the node
Click ☐ / ☑check or uncheck the checkbox
Click a linkwebsite — in the browser; file or folder — show in the file manager; another map — open here; branch link — jump to it
Drop a file or link onto a branchadd a child link branch (an image gets a preview)

Keys on the map

Tabnew child branch
Enternew sibling branch (on the root — a child)
Shift+Enterlist under the node
F2 Ctrl+Enteredit the title
Deletedelete the branch (the root cannot be deleted)
Spacecollapse or expand the branch
← → ↑ ↓to the parent / to the first child / to the sibling above / below
Alt+↑ Alt+↓move the branch up / down
Alt+← Alt+→promote / demote
Ctrl+C Ctrl+X Ctrl+Vcopy / cut / paste a branch (pasted as a child)
Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Zundo / redo
Escclose the menu, cancel a drag

Keys while editing text

Enterdone — in a title, list or note
Shift+Enternew line: line break in a title, next item in a list
Esccancel editing
Click elsewheresave the edit

File and view

Ctrl+N / Ctrl+Onew map / open (.md, .mm, .opml, .xmind)
Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+Ssave / save as
Ctrl+Pexport to PDF
Ctrl+Eshow or hide the Markdown source
Ctrl+= / Ctrl+-zoom in / out (Ctrl++ on the numeric keypad too)
Ctrl+0fit the map to the window
F1this help
Ctrl+Qquit (asks about unsaved changes)

Branch menu: color, collapse, move, copy, "Add Checkbox", "Add Note", "Branches: numbering", "List: numbering". Map menu: expand or collapse all.

Markdown

# Heading, ## Subheadingthe root and branches by level
- item (or * item, + item), nested — indentedbranches inside a heading
a paragraph of textalso a branch

@tutorial:
# Tutorial
> Do a task, then click its ☐. This is a practice map: edit freely, Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
> The edit field shows the markup: "[ ] " at the start of a line is the checkbox.

## 1. Editing text
- [ ] Double-click this line — edit right in the node, Enter to finish
- [ ] Click a branch to select it and press F2 — also edits

## 2. New branches
- [ ] Select "Sandbox" and press Tab — a child branch appears, type text and press Enter
- [ ] Select the new branch and press Enter — a sibling appears in edit mode; press Enter again, then Delete to remove it
- Sandbox

## 3. Branch order
- [ ] Grab "Third" with the mouse and drop it on the top third of "First" — it lands before it
- [ ] Select "Second" and press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ — the same from the keyboard
- First
- Second
- Third

## 4. List and note under a branch
- [ ] Select "Shopping" and press Shift+Enter, type the items (Shift+Enter for the next one), Enter to finish
- [ ] Right-click "Shopping" → "Add Note"
- Shopping

## 5. Checkboxes and numbering
- [ ] Right-click "Steps" → "Add Checkbox"
- [ ] Right-click "Steps" → "Branches: numbering" — the items become 1, 2
- Steps
  - one
  - two

## 6. Links
- [ ] Click the [link to section 1](#1-editing-text) — the map jumps to that branch
- [ ] [markmap website](https://markmap.js.org) — opens in the browser
- [ ] Drop a file from the file manager onto "Sandbox" — a link branch appears

## 7. Markdown source
- [ ] Press Ctrl+E — Markdown opens beside the map; change a line there and the map updates
- [ ] Press Ctrl+E again to hide it

## 8. Saving and help
- [ ] Ctrl+S saves the map (asks for a name), Ctrl+P exports to PDF
- [ ] F1 or "?" — help: all keys and syntax
